name: download-manager

_wpdm_file_browser_root.note: Settings::basic() stores realpath(get_home_path() . '/' . $posted); an absolute host path is never portable intent.

_wpdm_file_browser_access.note: Grants filesystem browsing to named roles beside the target-local root above. It stays with the root it qualifies.

__wpdm_tmp_storage.note: Chooses 'db' or a target-local temporary directory for download assembly.

__wpdm_author_profile.note: Settings::frontEnd() reads this with wpdm_query_var(..., 'int') and adds a rewrite rule from that page's post_name. Apply.php:195-198 also self-heals it to a freshly created page id.

__wpdm_user_dashboard.note: Welcome.php:80 and Apply.php:184-191 both write a page id here; wpdm-functions.php:712 resolves it as a post id. Its wp_dropdown_pages control (profile-dashboard.php:7) sets option_none_value to the empty string, which (int)-casts to the engine's durable-zero unset contract (OptionsCapture.php:735-742) — the same zero every reader here already applies.

__wpdm_blocked_emails.note: Operator-authored rejection list for signup addresses. It is an authored policy list, not captured visitor data; no sibling clearance is granted.

__wpdm_blocked_ips.note: Deployment-specific address blocklist. Source-site addresses are not intent at a different target.

__wpdm_cat_desc.note: Settings::basic() retains only the pruning half of these three category-listing toggles (Settings.php:147-149 deletes each when unposted); 3.3.68 ships no input that writes one. A value present on an upgraded site is pre-3.3.68 residue with no writer to reproduce it.

__wpdm_cpage.note: Global category-page layout defaults (template, cols, colspad, colsphone, heading, items_per_page) read at Categories.php:152-153. The per-term override is term_meta __wpdm_pagestyle, which carries the identical member shape and the same non-reference declaration.

__wpdm_curl_base.note: Category permalink base. A slug is authored routing intent, unlike the absolute URLs this capsule refuses below.

__wpdm_email_setting.note: Operator-authored from-name/from-address notification identity, not a captured recipient.

__wpdm_front_end_access.note: Role slugs. Settings::frontEnd() adds or removes upload_files on exactly these roles when saved natively; direct engine writes run none of that, which is why the disposition withholds apply.

__wpdm_gutenberg_editor.note: Feeds show_in_rest for wpdmpro and wpdmcategory at download-manager.php:303 and :350, so it changes the editor a target registers.

__wpdm_mask_link.note: basic.php:333 posts the unchecked value beside the checkbox, so the pair always writes one of the two states.

__wpdm_ui_colors.note: Installer.php:180-182 seeds exactly eighteen colour scalars; the user-interface form posts the same keyspace.

__wpdm_ui_download_button.note: user-interface.php posts color/size/br members under this one name; the __wpdm_ui_download_button_color style class names beside them are CSS hooks, not options.

_wpdm_etpl.note: Read once by the legacy emails-template.php view; its save-etpl handler no longer exists in 3.3.68, so this is read-only residue rather than authored intent.

__wpdmcategory.note: The pre-term-meta category store CategoryController.php:118-155 still reads as a fallback. Categories::saveMetaData writes term meta instead and its option write is commented out, so 3.3.68 never authors this.

_fm_link_templates.note: Operator-authored custom link templates. PackageTemplate.php:23 clamps templateType to exactly link|page, so link and page are the whole family plus Templates.php's email status row.

__wpdm_activity_report_emails.note: Operator-authored report recipients typed into the activity-report settings form, not addresses harvested from visitors.

__wpdm_access.note: Role slugs allowed to download. PackageController::metaData() types it 'array'.

__wpdm_additional_previews.note: PackageController.php:2493-2495 iterates the stored value as $media_id, so these are attachment post ids, not URLs.

__wpdm_captcha_lock.note: 0/1 captcha lock from lock-options.php. A toggle's small value collides with small post ids, so the non-reference semantics are declared rather than left to a per-environment lint coincidence.

__wpdm_changelog.note: savePackage sanitizes id/version/date/changes/timestamp per entry; the whole structure is authored release copy.

__wpdm_download_limit_per_user.note: Per-user download allowance, typed 'int' by the same reader.

__wpdm_files.note: Names files under the plugin upload directory, or absolute URLs. The names are authored intent; this capsule claims nothing about moving the bytes those names point at.

__wpdm_individual_file_download.note: 0/1 per-file download toggle on the package.

__wpdm_media_access.note: Lives on attachments, not on wpdmpro. MediaAccessControl.php:271 writes it for core media rows, so it must be classified even where no package exists.

__wpdm_private.note: Attachment-scoped private flag read at MediaAccessControl.php:58; a 0/1 flag, never an entity id.

__wpdm_quota.note: PackageController::metaData() types this 'int': a download allowance, never an entity id.

__wpdm_template.note: Link template basename resolved at Shortcodes.php:66; wp_basename() is applied before the file is fetched.

__wpdm_terms_lock.note: 0/1 terms lock from lock-options.php. Measured: on a fresh conformance fixture its value 1 coincided with page id 1 and the lint reported a bare_id.

__wpdm_items_per_page.note: Shortcodes.php:349 writes this on the EMBEDDING post during [wpdm_search_result] render, so any post type can carry it.

__wpdm_link_template.note: Also written on the embedding post at Shortcodes.php:342 during render. Distinct from the authored __wpdm_template above.

__wpdm_package_size.note: Human-readable size recomputed from __wpdm_files. No provider is claimed; apply and deploy stay unsupported until an exact bounded rebuild is proven.

__wpdm_package_size_b.note: Byte count written at PackageController.php:836 from the same file walk.

__wpdm_icon.note: Stored as an absolute URL (icons.php renders it through esc_url). Nothing in this slice rebinds a scalar meta URL to a target home, so carrying it would point a target at the source site.

__wpdm_preview.note: package-settings.php:307 posts attachment.url, so this is the same unrebindable absolute-URL shape as __wpdm_icon.

__wpdm_masterkey.note: Crypt::encrypt([id, time]) under the target's own __wpdm_enc_key. savePackage regenerates it when absent, so a target mints its own.

__wpdm_media_pass.note: Attachment access password stored verbatim at MediaAccessControl.php:272.

__wpdm_password.note: savePackage deliberately stores this without sanitization ('don't alter/sanitize password'). It is a shared download credential, so it stays with the target that issued it.

__wpdm_terms_page.note: wp_dropdown_pages() with show_option_none stores WordPress's -1 sentinel for 'use custom content below'. A scalar post ref has no sentinel grammar in this slice, so binding it as a reference would either resolve -1 or silently drop the operator's choice. Held target-local until sentinel handling is designed and exercised.

__wpdm_pagestyle.note: The per-term category-page layout override: a template basename plus cols/colspad/colsphone/heading/items_per_page counts. Measured: on a fresh conformance fixture cols=3, colspad=2, colsphone=1 and heading=1 each coincided with a real post id and the lint reported four bare_ids. No member here is ever an entity reference.

__wpdm_icon.note: Category icon URL, same unrebindable absolute-URL shape as the post_meta rule of this name. term_meta and post_meta are separate sections, so the two rules never collide.

notes: Experimental authoring capsule measured against the exact official Download Manager 3.3.68 artifact in this capsule's evidence lock. Every rule below was read out of that artifact's source; none has a completed live conformance run behind it. No certification, deployment, apply, deletion, lifecycle or production-readiness claim.

download-manager.php:320 registers exactly one post type (wpdmpro) and :346/:370 register wpdmcategory and wpdmtag over it. wpdmtag is conditional: a site defining WPDM_USE_POST_TAGS, or redefining WPDM_TAG to 'post_tag', gets register_taxonomy_for_object_type('post_tag', 'wpdmpro') instead (:348, :382), so packages carry core tags and no wpdmtag term exists for this rule to match. wpdmpro supports 'editor', and show_in_rest is the __wpdm_gutenberg_editor option, so post_content is ordinary editor content and takes the engine's default body mode rather than a declared codec.

Package metadata is written by one uniform loop: Packages.php:75-115 stores every $_POST['file'][<k>] as __wpdm_<k>, deleting any prior __wpdm_ key the form did not post except __wpdm_favs and __wpdm_masterkey. Each key here is therefore classified individually; declaring the post type without classifying them would abort capture with unclassified_state, which is the intended loud boundary rather than a blanket authored grant.

Three families are deliberately held target-local rather than carried. Absolute stored URLs (__wpdm_icon on posts and terms, __wpdm_preview) have no scalar-meta rebinding path in this slice. Credentials (__wpdm_password, __wpdm_media_pass, __wpdm_masterkey, the social and reCAPTCHA secrets, __wpdm_enc_key, __wpdm_cron_key) never become authored configuration. __wpdm_terms_page stores WordPress's -1 'none' sentinel from wp_dropdown_pages, which a scalar post reference cannot express here.

Settings::basic() and its five sibling savers persist ANY posted key matching _wpdm_ (Settings.php:129-140), so the option namespace is open by construction. The exact rules here cover what the shipped free-plugin settings views post, including the three category-listing toggles that release now only prunes. The two option patterns cover the md5 update-notice markers minted at wpdm-core.php:347 and the __wpdm_etpl_<id> email templates written at Templates.php:84, whose shipped ids are exactly default, user-signup, user-signup-admin, user-signup-approved, user-signup-declined and user-signup-suspended (Email.php:119-175). An add-on option outside both stays unclassified and is simply not captured.

Widget id_bases are derived, not declared: every widget class calls parent::__construct(false, ...), so WP_Widget lowercases the class name. WPDM_Categories, WPDM_Tags and PackageInfo are omitted here because their update() returns $new_instance wholesale or stores a nested checkbox map, and neither shape has been exercised.

The eight ahm_* tables created by Installer.php:47-126 are download statistics, email queue, social connections, assets, sessions, per-user counters and cron jobs. All are runtime and deliberately excluded from the portable row set.

Not claimed and not silently absorbed: user metadata (__wpdm_favs, __wpdm_public_profile and siblings), the fifteen user, category, media and asset-manager shortcodes beyond the three package-id ones declared, __wpdm_category post meta (its only writer, wpdm_cblist_categories at wpdm-core.php:91, has no caller in the free plugin and emits term slugs rather than ids), and every Pro or add-on surface.
